techParks.name: HAL Bangalore Complex
techParks.description: The government aerospace cluster around HAL Airport: HAL's Bangalore Complex (Aircraft, Overhaul, Foundry & Forge, Aerospace, LCA Tejas divisions), Helicopter Complex and Design Complex line HAL Old Airport Road from Vimanapura to Marathahalli, with URSC, NAL Kodihalli and ADA on the same road. Centroid is the Vimanapura locality; bbox is the union of the mapped HAL/URSC/NAL/ARDC polygons.

techParks.name: DRDO Complex, C V Raman Nagar
aliases: DRDO Phase 1, C V Raman Nagar
DRDO Township C V Raman Nagar
techParks.description: DRDO's Bengaluru campus at C V Raman Nagar housing LRDE (radars), CAIR (AI and robotics), CASDIC (ex-DARE avionics) and GTRE (aero-engines), with HAL's Engine Division and IMGT Division next door. Centroid averaged from the LRDE, CAIR and GTRE OSM polygons.

techParks.name: Peenya Industrial Area
techParks.description: One of Asia's largest industrial estates in north-west Bengaluru; for this lens it hosts ISRO's ISTRAC mission control (2nd Phase) and LEOS electro-optics lab (1st Phase), with CMTI and HMT's Jalahalli plant on its Tumkur Road edge. Point is Nominatim's Peenya Industrial Area centroid; no park polygon in the OSM extract.

techParks.name: BEL Industrial Estate, Jalahalli
techParks.description: BEL's founding (1954) factory campus at Jalahalli, holding the Bangalore unit, Central Research Laboratory, Product Development & Innovation Centre, BEL Academy for Excellence, the BEL-Thales Systems joint venture and DRDO's MTRDC. Point is Nominatim's 'Bharat Electronics Limited' feature; no named polygon in the OSM extract.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1
notableTenants: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing
techParks.description: The state-developed (KEONICS) electronics estate on Hosur Road; this lens's tenants are C-DOT's campus, C-DAC's unit, BHEL's Electronics Systems Division and ITI Spacenet, all in Phase 1. Point is Nominatim's Electronics City Phase 1 centroid; other researchers cover its IT majors.

techParks.name: ISRO HQ Campus (Antariksh Bhavan)
techParks.description: The Department of Space / ISRO headquarters campus (Antariksh Bhavan) on New BEL Road, which also houses the Human Space Flight Centre, NSIL's registered office and Antrix. Polygon is OSM way/42396273.

coverageNotes: Shared WebSearch budget was exhausted after the first four searches, so verification ran on direct fetches of official pages/PDFs, Wikipedia (as a lead) and the OSM extracts plus Nominatim/Photon. Confirmed from primary sources: every HAL Bengaluru division address (contact page + division mailing-address PDF), ADA (Contact Us PDF), ISTRAC, LEOS, URSC, HSFC, NSIL (both offices), BEML Soudha, ITI Bhavan, HMT Bhavan and HMT Jalahalli, C-DOT, CPRI, DRDO ADE/CABS/GTRE/CAIR/CASDIC (DRDO lists). Not confirmed from the company: BEL (bel-india.in answered 503 throughout; addresses come from the WebSearch summary of BEL's own RTI PDFs plus the Nominatim 'Bharat Electronics Limited' feature), Antrix and KSDL (sites 503), CMTI (503), C-DAC Bengaluru (404 on its centre page), BSNL Karnataka (DNS failure), Canara Bank (contact page carried no address, BSE/Moneycontrol refused) and MTRDC (DRDO and Wikipedia pages 404) - each is marked medium or low with the reason in its evidence sentence. Coordinates: HAL Overhaul and Foundry & Forge divisions, CASDIC, DEBEL, HSFC, NSIL registered office, Antrix and MTRDC have no mapped boundary and are pinned to their campus centroid (geocodeSource park-centroid, confidence medium/low); CEMILAC is pinned to the Marathahalli Colony post office (low). Deliberately left out: KSRTC/BMTC, IISc and other institutes (NIMHANS, RRI, IIA, JNCASR), NPCIL, Bharat Dynamics, MIDHANI, Mazagon and NTPC (no Bengaluru operation in scope), the HMT Watch Factory (closed 2016, before the 2023 cut-off), KEONICS/KIADB (state agencies, not in the lens list), BEL's joint ventures (BEL-Thales at Jalahalli, GE-BE at Whitefield are separate companies), and ISRO's 'ISRO Data Centre' polygon at Peenya (no source naming it). IDSN Byalalu (12.9006, 77.3701) is inside the lng >= 77.35 box by two kilometres and is included as an ISTRAC site with that caveat. BHEL's Electro Porcelains Division is kept as low confidence because bhel.com's current footprint map no longer lists it; headcounts are not given per city anywhere, so bengaluruEmployeesApprox is null throughout.
